intro: Lesson 49: 7K review and quiz: forces. To understand how secure my knowledge of forces, springs, pressure and motion is

model.title: Explain why a ball rolling on carpet slows down and stops. [4 marks]

parts.label: Step 1
parts.text: Friction from the carpet acts on the ball (1)

parts.label: Step 3
parts.text: Forces are unbalanced; resultant is backwards (1)

parts.label: Step 4
parts.text: So the ball decelerates until it stops (1)

questions.q: A 60 kg pupil stands on 0.03 m². Pressure? (g = 10 N/kg)
questions.model: Weight first: 60 × 10 = 600 N. Then P = 600 ÷ 0.03 = 20 000 N/m².

questions.q: 7K quiz on the portal (12 questions, 15 minutes): forces, weight, springs, friction, pressure, resultant force, speed.
questions.a: Answer key on the teacher sheet; for example weight of 3 kg = 30 N; 500 N on 0.25 m² = 2000 N/m²
questions.model: Teacher reads question 1 aloud and models the layout: equation, substitution, answer, unit.

questions.q: Mark with the answer slide and write two targets in your book.
Big question: which force affects your day most?
